items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Yeah, I think Buddy Petit died, you know. Buddy used to get drunk so much, you know. But I always liked his playing. Yeah, Buddy was good, yeah.

ctx.x: So what about the trumpet players? In the outside, Joe Oliver and Guy Kelly and, let's see, Prince. What about Buddy Petit? Yeah, Buddy Petit. Yeah, Buddy Petit. Yeah, I think Buddy Petit died, you know. Buddy used to get drunk so much, you know. But I always liked his playing. Yeah, Buddy was good, yeah. Yeah. And, let me see, that brother man. George McCullum, you remember him? Yeah, I remember him. Yeah, I remember him. Yeah, I remember him. Him and his dad both played. Yeah.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Buddy used to tell us where you're going to make it, you know. And after a while, the other fellas, I and all of them, they picked it up, you see.

ctx.x: I'm going to ask you, just a moment. Turn it on. Come on in. I'm going to ask you when the trumpet players started running diminished chords and stuff.

Say, when did the trumpet players start running diminished chords and things? Well, see, Buddy, you know, Buddy Petee, he's the person I heard, you know. Buddy used to tell us where you're going to make it, you know. And after a while, the other fellas, I and all of them, they picked it up, you see. Buddy's the first one, though. Buddy Petee was the person I heard and made it. And the person who made the variation in high society, too, on the corner. Buddy Petee was, you know.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Used to work with Butter Petit too with me.

ctx.x: Well, what about, uh, who did George Lewis work with other than him?

So, who did George Lewis work with in them times? He's a kid. He's a kid. He's a kid when he's coming out. My dear George worked- worked with me more than any band ever worked with. Now, of course, he'd been working with a different band, but now he got the band of his own. Used to work with Butter Petit too with me. That's how we worked with Kid Howard. And then I came to work with Kid Howard. Wasn't he working with Kid Howard once? And then Jim Crow. You got his name too? Oh yeah, I know him. He used to play…
Ask him about Albert Martin. How about Albert Martin?

He said Louie never gives Buddy no credit. No. But Buddy was a good trumpet player. I hope to tell you. And Buddy could read too. Read yeah. Buddy kept out that liquor. Buddy used to put that music up there sometimes. Surprised as old. And he didn't like to read but he liked to play off. You know about that all the time. But still him and Louie was Buddy.
